headline: Everest Group (NYSE:EG) Delivers Solid Q2 Earnings as Underwriting Discipline and Revenue Beat Stand Out
summary: Everest Group posts Q2 EPS of $14.85, matching estimates, with revenue slightly above consensus. Underwriting discipline drives core combined ratio of 90.0%. Book value rises to $398.83.

headline: Everest Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: HAMILTON, Bermuda, July 29, 2026--Everest Group, Ltd. (NYSE: EG), a global underwriting leader providing best-in-class property, casualty, and specialty reinsurance and insurance solutions, today reported its second quarter 2026 results.
